info.title: Avenue D Pediatrics — Check-in API
info.description: REST API for the patient check-in system. Supports staff JWT auth (cookie or Bearer token) and API key auth (X-API-Key header) for server-to-server access.

staffJwt.description: Staff JWT token. Obtained from POST /auth/login.

oauth2.description: OAuth2 bearer token for external apps, issued and introspected by core-api. Used by the /v1/external/* surface.

get.summary: Auth configuration — tells clients which auth mode is active

post.summary: Staff logout — revokes the current JWT

get.summary: Get current authenticated user from JWT
Initiate SSO login with an identity provider

post.description: Public endpoint. Creates a patient record and queues insurance verification.

locationId.description: Location ID — assigned to patient at check-in

acknowledgedNPP.description: Must be true — HIPAA §164.520 NPP acknowledgement

sessionId.description: Opaque session token — legacy poll path

token.description: Patient-scoped JWT (4 h) — use with FHIR endpoints (Authorization: Bearer <token>)

encounterId.description: Patient/Encounter ID — use in FHIR path e.g. GET /fhir/r4/Encounter/:encounterId/$queue-status

get.summary: Validate session and get patient status

get.description: Returns real-time position, estimated wait, and status. Requires patient Bearer token (returned by POST /checkin). Poll this endpoint (e.g. every 30 s) to display wait info to the patient.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Opaque session token returned by POST /checkin

estimatedWaitMinutes.description: Estimated wait based on rolling throughput

minutesPerPatient.description: Current throughput rate (minutes per patient seen)

returnThresholdReached.description: True when patient should head back to the office

patch.description: Patient signals they are on their way back (RETURNING) or have arrived at the office (ARRIVED).

get.summary: Live patient queue updates (SSE) — signals a re-fetch on change

get.description: Returns all patients in CHECKED_IN, WAITING_OFFSITE, RETURNING, or ARRIVED status, ordered by queue position. Includes insurance verification details and current throughput rate.

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: Filter queue to a specific location

get.summary: Live queue (SSE) — pushed on check-in / status change

get.description: Returns SEEN, NO_SHOW, and CANCELLED patients checked in today (America/New_York), ordered by most-recently updated.

post.summary: Move a patient to a new queue position
post.description: Synchronously reassigns 1-based positions for all active patients. Logs the reason to the audit trail.

post.summary: Restore archived patient to live queue
post.description: Moves a SEEN/NO_SHOW/CANCELLED patient back to CHECKED_IN and appends them to the end of the queue.
Transitions a patient to a new status. Terminal statuses (SEEN, NO_SHOW, CANCELLED) and IN_ROOM clear the queue position and compact remaining positions.
Updates a patient's visit type (APPOINTMENT ↔ WALK_IN). Logged to audit trail.

post.summary: Correct patient name / date of birth
post.description: Updates a patient's full name and optionally date of birth. Logged to audit trail.
Sends a status-page link to the patient's email address on file. Returns 422 if the patient has no email.

patch.description: Partial update of patient name, DOB, phone, email, visit type, and guardian info. Only provided fields are updated.

get.description: Returns full demographics for a single patient including guardian info.

get.summary: List vendor-submitted intakes for a patient
get.description: Staff-authenticated, tenant-scoped read of third-party-vendor intake data for a patient. Returns VendorIntakeRef pointer rows (Shape B) plus vendor-originated FormSubmission / Consent / FormDocument summaries (Shape A). Content-in PHI (form answers) is fetched per-submission via the detail route. CLINICAL_READ role required.

get.summary: Read a vendor form submission's answers
get.description: Staff-authenticated, tenant- and patient-scoped read of a single vendor-submitted form submission, including its decrypted FHIR QuestionnaireResponse answers. CLINICAL_READ role required.
Returns the 200 most recent audit log entries, ordered newest first, including staff name and patient ID.

post.description: Computes and upserts a daily report (totals by status, visit type, and average wait time). Defaults to today; pass an optional `date` (YYYY-MM-DD, America/New_York) to (re)generate a past day's report. Regenerating overwrites the previous version.

date.description: Target day as YYYY-MM-DD (America/New_York). Omit for today.

get.description: Returns all saved end-of-day reports ordered newest first, including the name of the generating staff member.
Returns active staff accounts for the current practice. Pass ?showInactive=true to return inactive accounts instead. Pass ?locationId= or ?practiceId= to filter. ADMIN role required.

post.description: Resets another staff member's password and revokes all their active sessions. ADMIN role required. Admins cannot reset their own password via this endpoint.

newPassword.description: Must include uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character.

get.summary: Count staff rows not linked to a core identity (ADR-006)
get.description: Returns counts only (no names or emails). ADMIN role required. `unlinked` is the number of local Staff rows with no coreStaffId.

post.description: Creates a new staff or admin account. ADMIN role required. Returns 409 if the email is already in use.
Edits an existing staff account's name, email, or role. ADMIN role required. Returns 409 if the new email is already in use.
Adds 1–200 patients at once. Returns 201 if all rows succeeded, 207 (Multi-Status) if any rows failed. Each patient is queued for insurance verification and sent a status link email.

locationId.description: Assign all imported patients to this location

post.description: Re-triggers the Availity eligibility check for a single patient and resets their verification status to PENDING.
Re-triggers Availity eligibility checks for all active queue patients whose verification is not VERIFIED or SKIPPED. Pass `force: true` to re-verify even already-verified patients.
Marks a patient's insurance as VERIFIED with a staff note, bypassing Availity. Also assigns a queue position if the patient doesn't have one. Logged to audit trail.

post.summary: Edit patient insurance info and re-verify
post.description: Updates payer ID and member ID, resets verification to PENDING, and re-queues an Availity eligibility check.
Soft-deactivates a staff account and revokes all their active sessions. Account can be reactivated later. ADMIN role required. Admins cannot deactivate their own account.
Reactivates a previously deactivated staff account. ADMIN role required.

post.summary: Schedule leave for a staff account
post.description: Sets a leave window for a staff account. If inactiveFrom <= now the account is deactivated immediately. inactiveTo is optional (null = indefinite leave). ADMIN role required.

post.summary: Cancel leave for a staff account
post.description: Clears any scheduled or active leave and reactivates the account immediately. ADMIN role required.

get.description: Returns all deactivated staff, providers, rooms, and locations. ADMIN role required.
Returns payers stored in the DB from the last Availity payer-list sync. Supports search, pagination via limit/offset. ADMIN role required.

post.description: Enqueues a BullMQ job to fetch the latest payer list from Availity and upsert into the DB. Returns 202 Accepted immediately. ADMIN role required.

get.description: Returns all active providers. Pass ?all=true to include inactive. Pass ?locationId= to filter to a specific location.

post.description: Sets a leave window for a provider. If inactiveFrom <= now the provider is deactivated immediately. inactiveTo is optional (null = indefinite).

delete.description: Clears any scheduled or active leave and reactivates the provider immediately.

post.summary: Assign a provider to a patient

get.description: Returns all active rooms. Pass ?all=true to include inactive. Pass ?locationId= to filter by location.

post.summary: Assign a room to a patient

get.summary: Get per-location default room and provider

get.description: Returns a QR code encoding the check-in landing URL. No PHI is embedded — patients enter their info after scanning. Staff JWT required. Use for lobby signage or printed materials.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: png (default) → image/png buffer; svg → image/svg+xml string; dataurl → JSON { dataUrl, url }

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: Embed a locationId in the check-in URL so patients are auto-assigned to this location on scan

200.description: QR code. For dataurl format, returns JSON; for png/svg returns binary content.

schema.description: QR code. For dataurl format, returns JSON; for png/svg returns binary content.

url.description: The encoded check-in URL (dataurl format only)

post.description: Generates a scoped API key for a client. The raw key is returned once and cannot be retrieved again.

clientName.description: Human-readable name for the client (e.g. 'Mobile App')

scopes.description: List of permission scopes granted to this key

key.description: Raw API key — shown once, store securely

get.description: Returns all API keys (active and revoked). Raw keys are never returned.

delete.description: Permanently deactivates an API key. Cannot be undone.

get.description: Returns the SMART on FHIR capability statement. Clients use this to locate the authorization and token endpoints.
Validates the client, checks the staff session, and issues an authorization code. Redirects to the client redirect_uri with ?code=…&state=…

post.description: Exchanges an authorization code (+ PKCE code_verifier) for a scoped access token. Accepts application/x-www-form-urlencoded or application/json.
Returns active status and claims for a SMART access token. Requires a registered client_id.
Immediately revokes a SMART access token. The token will be rejected by introspection and resource endpoints.

get.description: Machine-readable description of this check-in API's auth surface: the authorization server that issues its tokens (ac-core) and the checkin:* scopes it accepts. ac-checkin is a resource server — get the token endpoint from the authorization_servers' own discovery.

post.description: Registers a new SMART App Launch client. For CONFIDENTIAL clients the clientSecret is returned once and cannot be retrieved again.
Issues a short-lived (15 min) elevated token scoped to one patient. Requires a documented reason. All invocations are audit-logged and queued for post-event review.

get.description: Returns all break-glass invocations that have not yet been reviewed (no matching BREAK_GLASS_REVIEWED entry).

patch.summary: Close a break-glass event with disposition
patch.description: Records the reviewer's disposition as a new BREAK_GLASS_REVIEWED audit entry (original entry is never modified).

post.description: Issues a short-lived (15 min) elevated token scoped to one patient. Requires a documented reason. All invocations are audit-logged and queued for post-event review.

get.description: Returns all break-glass invocations that have not yet been reviewed (no matching BREAK_GLASS_REVIEWED entry).

patch.summary: Close a break-glass event with disposition
patch.description: Records the reviewer's disposition as a new BREAK_GLASS_REVIEWED audit entry (original entry is never modified).

get.summary: List practice memberships for a staff member

post.summary: Assign a per-practice role to a staff member

delete.summary: Remove a per-practice role assignment from a staff member

get.summary: List locations for the current practice
List practices assigned to a provider

post.summary: Assign a practice to a provider

delete.summary: Unassign a practice from a provider

get.summary: Read back a form submission (OAuth, tenant-scoped)

post.summary: Request a pre-signed upload URL for a form document (OAuth, tenant-scoped)

externalId.description: Vendor's stable id for this document; idempotency key within a practice.

corePatientId.description: Astrum core Patient id (the id core returns; not an MRN).

contentType.description: e.g. application/pdf. Must equal the Content-Type sent on the presigned PUT.

filename.description: Only the extension is kept for the storage key; the base name is never stored (may hold PHI).

sha256.description: 64-char hex SHA-256 of the file (integrity metadata).

practiceSlug.description: Optional; needed only when the token is bound to multiple practices.

get.summary: Get a form document's metadata + pre-signed download URL (OAuth, tenant-scoped)

post.summary: Mark a pre-signed upload complete (verifies the object landed; OAuth, tenant-scoped)

patch.summary: Reschedule / cancel / update an appointment (OAuth, tenant-scoped)

post.summary: Create/update a bookable schedule (OAuth, tenant-scoped, idempotent)
Publish a recurring availability rule + generate slots (OAuth, tenant-scoped)
Mark an appointment arrived and land the patient into the check-in queue (OAuth, tenant-scoped)
Record a vendor intake reference (OAuth, tenant-scoped, idempotent, pointer-only)

get.summary: List vendor intake references (OAuth, tenant-scoped, pointer-only)
List a patient's form documents, incl. voided (staff, role-gated)

post.summary: Request a pre-signed upload URL for a form document (staff, role-gated)

externalId.description: Your stable id for this document; idempotency key within a practice.

corePatientId.description: Astrum core Patient id (the id core returns; not an MRN).

contentType.description: e.g. application/pdf. Must equal the Content-Type sent on the presigned PUT.

filename.description: Only the extension is kept for the storage key; the base name is never stored (may hold PHI).

sha256.description: 64-char hex SHA-256 of the file (integrity metadata).

post.summary: Upload a form document directly (staff, role-gated) — multipart/form-data
post.description: Direct multipart upload. Send `file` (max 50MB; PDF, image, or office/word-processor document), `corePatientId`, and optional `documentType`. Requires the DOCUMENT_UPLOADER or ADMIN role and the X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest header.

file.description: The document (PDF, image, or office/word-processor file). Max 50MB.

corePatientId.description: Astrum core Patient id (the id core returns; not an MRN).

get.summary: Get a form document's metadata + pre-signed download URL (staff, role-gated)

post.description: Marks the document voided (status: "voided") with an audited reason. The row and the stored object are retained — never deleted — and the document stays downloadable for retention.

reason.description: Why the document is being voided (1–200 chars).

get.summary: Previously-used custom document-type names, ranked by frequency (staff, role-gated)

get.description: Default returns { types: string[] } (active names, for the upload dropdown). With ?detail=1 (ADMIN only) returns { items: [{ id, name, active }] } including inactive rows, for the admin management UI.

post.summary: Promote a custom document-type name into the official dropdown (ADMIN)

name.description: The custom name to promote (same convention as an upload name).

get.summary: Frequent custom document-type names not yet promoted (ADMIN)
Search patients by name or MRN (staff) — proxied to core identity
get.description: Forwards the staff session to core's patient search. Core matches partial name or MRN and scopes results to the caller's practices.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Name or MRN fragment; core does the fuzzy matching.

post.description: Generates a scoped API key for a client. The raw key is returned once and cannot be retrieved again.

clientName.description: Human-readable name for the client (e.g. 'Mobile App')

scopes.description: List of permission scopes granted to this key

key.description: Raw API key — shown once, store securely

get.description: Returns all API keys (active and revoked). Raw keys are never returned.

delete.description: Permanently deactivates an API key. Cannot be undone.
